author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@kevinmarks @anildash Ahhh SVG, we finally figured a way to turn those pesky images into code (joking I get the lightweight low resource benefits)

I jest because I do believe the semantic focus you bring Kevin is part of the DNA of the web as people have had this debate since the first browser.

In terms of the silos I am hoping web responsive apps do win out over native mobile apps. You know I share the dream of indie readers and everyone publishing on their own space and sharing how they want.

In terms of bitmap infographic. Just have to wait for someone to build an SVG infographic maker in Glitch.
